chapterInfo.content:
8
Bildad asɛnka a ɛdi kan
Ahonu de ahotɔ ba
1Ɛnna Suhini Bildad gyee so sɛ:
2Ɛnkɔsi berɛ bɛn na wobɛka yeinom,
na w’anomu nsɛm bɛyɛ sɛ mframa denden yi?
3 # Hiob 34.10 Onyankopɔn bɛkyea atemmuo
anaasɛ Otumfoɔ bɛkyea tenenee?
4 # Hiob 1.18-19 Sɛ wo mma ayɛ no bɔne a,
wagyaa wɔn de wɔn ahyɛ wɔn mmarato nsam.
5Sɛ wo ara wohwehwɛ Nyankopɔn akyiri kwan,
na wokoto srɛ Otumfoɔ no,
6 # Dwom 35.23 sɛ wo ho te na wotene a,
ampa ara ɔbɛkanyan ne ho ama wo,
na wama wo tenenee tenabea no adi yie.
7 # Hiob 42.10 Na sɛ mpo wo mfitiaseɛ yɛ ketewa a,
w’awieeɛ bɛso kokuroo.
8Mesrɛ wo, bisa awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ ɛ,
na ma w’akoma mmra deɛ wɔn agyanom ahwehwɛ ahunu no so.
9 # Dwom 102.12 Na yɛn deɛ, nnora nko ara na yɛfiri hɔnom,
na yɛnnim hwee, ɛfiri sɛ yɛn nna te sɛ sunsum asase so.
10Ɛnyɛ wɔn na wɔbɛkyerɛ wo na wɔaka akyerɛ woɔ anaa,
na wɔayiyi nsɛm afiri wɔn akoma mu?
11Nkyɛkyerɛ fifiri deɛ ɔwora nnie, anaasɛ
mmɛwa bɛma ne ho so deɛ nsuo nnie?
12Ɛda so wɔ ne frɔmfrɔmyɛ mu a wɔntwaeɛ no,
ɛdi wura nyinaa anim kusa.
13 # Hiob 11.20; 18.14; Mmb 10.28 Saa ara na wɔn a wɔn werɛ firi Onyankopɔn nyinaa akwan teɛ,
na ɔbɔnefoɔ anidasoɔ bɛyera,
14ɛfiri sɛ wɔtwa deɛ ɔde ne ho to soɔ,
na n’anidasoɔ yɛ ananse ntentan.
15Ɔtwere ne dan, na ɛrennyina,
ɔkura mu, nso ɛrentena hɔ.
16Ɔyɛ frɔmfrɔm owia ano,
na ne mman yiyi kata ne turo so,
17ne nhini mantammantam aboɔkuo ho,
ɔhyɛne aboɔ ntam.
18Sɛ wɔsɛe no firi ne tenabea a,
ɛpa no ka sɛ: Menhunuu wo da.
19Hwɛ, sɛdeɛ ne kwan ho ahosɛpɛ teɛ ne no,
na mfuturo no mu na afoforɔ fifire.
20Hwɛ, Onyankopɔn mpo deɛ ɔdi mu,
na abɔnefoɔ nso, ɔnsɔ wɔn nsa.
21 # Dwom 126.2 Ɔde sereɛ bɛhyɛ w’anomu ma,
na wama ahurisie nne afa w’anofafa mu.
22W’atamfo bɛfira aniwuo,
na abɔnefoɔ ntomadan rennyina hɔ bio.

pageProps.chapterText:
Ɛnna Suhini Bildad gyee so sɛ:
Ɛnkɔsi berɛ bɛn na wobɛka yeinom,
na w’anomu nsɛm bɛyɛ sɛ mframa denden yi?
Onyankopɔn bɛkyea atemmuo
anaasɛ Otumfoɔ bɛkyea tenenee?
Sɛ wo mma ayɛ no bɔne a,
wagyaa wɔn de wɔn ahyɛ wɔn mmarato nsam.
Sɛ wo ara wohwehwɛ Nyankopɔn akyiri kwan,
na wokoto srɛ Otumfoɔ no,
sɛ wo ho te na wotene a,
ampa ara ɔbɛkanyan ne ho ama wo,
na wama wo tenenee tenabea no adi yie.
Na sɛ mpo wo mfitiaseɛ yɛ ketewa a,
w’awieeɛ bɛso kokuroo.

Mesrɛ wo, bisa awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ ɛ,
na ma w’akoma mmra deɛ wɔn agyanom ahwehwɛ ahunu no so.
Na yɛn deɛ, nnora nko ara na yɛfiri hɔnom,
na yɛnnim hwee, ɛfiri sɛ yɛn nna te sɛ sunsum asase so.
Ɛnyɛ wɔn na wɔbɛkyerɛ wo na wɔaka akyerɛ woɔ anaa,
na wɔayiyi nsɛm afiri wɔn akoma mu?

Nkyɛkyerɛ fifiri deɛ ɔwora nnie, anaasɛ
mmɛwa bɛma ne ho so deɛ nsuo nnie?
Ɛda so wɔ ne frɔmfrɔmyɛ mu a wɔntwaeɛ no,
ɛdi wura nyinaa anim kusa.
Saa ara na wɔn a wɔn werɛ firi Onyankopɔn nyinaa akwan teɛ,
na ɔbɔnefoɔ anidasoɔ bɛyera,
ɛfiri sɛ wɔtwa deɛ ɔde ne ho to soɔ,
na n’anidasoɔ yɛ ananse ntentan.
Ɔtwere ne dan, na ɛrennyina,
ɔkura mu, nso ɛrentena hɔ.
Ɔyɛ frɔmfrɔm owia ano,
na ne mman yiyi kata ne turo so,
ne nhini mantammantam aboɔkuo ho,
ɔhyɛne aboɔ ntam.
Sɛ wɔsɛe no firi ne tenabea a,
ɛpa no ka sɛ: Menhunuu wo da.
Hwɛ, sɛdeɛ ne kwan ho ahosɛpɛ teɛ ne no,
na mfuturo no mu na afoforɔ fifire.

Hwɛ, Onyankopɔn mpo deɛ ɔdi mu,
na abɔnefoɔ nso, ɔnsɔ wɔn nsa.
Ɔde sereɛ bɛhyɛ w’anomu ma,
na wama ahurisie nne afa w’anofafa mu.
W’atamfo bɛfira aniwuo,
na abɔnefoɔ ntomadan rennyina hɔ bio.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
